# Let's get all transactions for May 2023 by paginating through all pages.
venmo_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ2ZW5tbyttYXJfYmxhY0BnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODU1NTkwMTh9.NOFo98z_c-Q7v9MN1oawvADo6kpaFWi--kCl3LEOHRI'
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, min_created_at='2023-05-01', max_created_at='2023-05-31', page_limit=20, page_index=page_index)
    if not page:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total transactions fetched: {len(all_transactions)}")
